text:
marie-peopleops: quick check 4 Sam (intern) conversion request. Manager asks L2->L3 comp bump, one-time sign-on of $8k, and prorated equity for year 1. Start 2026-07-01. Need routing and clawback guidance.

hana-recruit: Candidate verbally accepted pending offer. Manager asked for benefits to start on day 1.

kevin-mgr: Context: Sam owns migration work, risk of counteroffer. Prefer 6-month clawback. Base request: $120k, sign-on $8k, equity 1000 RSUs prorated.

marie-peopleops: Please paste manager justification and headcount code. We'll kick off exception routing.

kevin-mgr: Justification: "Critical infra knowledge; immediate project impact; external interest." Headcount ENG-2026-07-MIG.

finance-ops: Quick flag: 6.7% above band midpoint. Mark as hiring premium. Need final cost calc. Approve to committee if packet complete.

payroll-bot: To enable benefits on 7/1 we need signed offer + HRIS entry by COB Tue. Off-cycle equity proration requires equity-team approval.

legal-bot: 6-month clawback ok in WA normally; include repayment terms and notice period. For non-US hires we'd advise 12 months.

marie-peopleops: Routing path: recruiting lead -> finance -> people-ops exceptions committee -> legal sign-off. I'll start routing now.

talent-ops: Noted. We'll prep standardized clawback language if legal approves.

kevin-mgr: ETA: will send written acceptance within 48 hrs after offer email.

marie-peopleops: Thanks. Committee meets tomorrow morning; if approved we'll issue same-day. Keep thread short. :white_check_mark:
